entries.title: U, UC, R Figures & Evolution Update
changes: This update brings multiple new figures of different rarity such as common, uncommon and rare. The figures can evolve when they defeat an opponent. This makes winning a battle more rewarding for the best duelers!
🧩 C & UC FIGURES
Added a large batch of Common (C) and Uncommon (UC) Pokémon figures to the game.
Added support for their associated Abilities, move effects and evolution options.
🧬 EVOLUTION SYSTEM
Added full Evolution Lines, allowing Pokémon to be equipped with multiple consecutive evolutions.
Evolution stages must remain connected and cannot be skipped, such as Abra → Kadabra → Alakazam → Mega Alakazam.
The Evolution Editor now displays the entire equipped Evolution Line at the top of the screen.
Only valid Pokémon for the next stage of an Evolution Line are shown when selecting evolutions.
Pokémon in the Evolution Line can now be hovered to view their full Pokémon information card.
Pokémon now evolve after winning a battle, including victories that do not knock out the opponent.
Draws do not trigger Evolution.
🔍 POKÉMON INFORMATION
Added an Evolution preview shortcut during battles. Hover over a Pokémon and press E to cycle through its equipped Evolution Line.
Reaching the final Evolution with the E shortcut loops the preview back to the base Pokémon.
Evolution previews are informational only and do not change the Pokémon currently on the board.
Pokémon information cards now use one continuous scrollbar for easier navigation.
👥 TEAMS & MULTIPLAYER
Opponent team selections are now hidden during multiplayer Team Selection.
Players now display only their Choosing Team or Ready status instead of revealing their Pokémon and Plates.
🤖 AI
Improved AI Goal awareness for Pokémon whose Abilities prevent them from winning by occupying the opponent's Goal.
📜 PATCH NOTES
